related.description: MCP for semantic code search & navigation that reduces token waste
A fast, local, indexed code search tool optimized for AI coding assistants. Written in Rust using Tantivy for full-text indexing.
Local repo-intelligence index + MCP server: semantic search, symbol/graph navigation, impact-surface preflight, git + GitHub papertrail, and...
Create terminal-based histograms, bar graphs, tables, heatmaps and more in realtime using regex and expressions.
